s.how: Tear 300g roast chicken and mix with 3 tbsp mayo and lemon juice. Pile into 4 soft rolls with sliced avocado and crisp cos. Wrap tight in paper for the boat.
Cut 500g calamari into strips and soak in 200ml buttermilk. Dredge in 100g cornmeal and 50g flour and fry at 185C for 90 seconds. Serve with tartare and lemon wedges.

m.how: Boil 600g new potatoes for 10 minutes in a big pot. Add 4 halved corn cobs, 200g sliced smoked sausage, 60g butter and a splash of water, then 1kg clams and 500g prawns. Cover and steam 8 minutes. Tip it all onto the table.

w.how: Toss 500g blueberries with 80g sugar and lemon juice in a dish. Rub 80g butter into 200g self-raising flour, add 150ml milk and drop over the fruit. Bake at 190C for 40 minutes. Serve with vanilla ice cream.

d.note: the sailing day out on the water
d.how: Stir 240ml golden rum, 400ml pineapple juice, 200ml orange juice, 80ml lime juice and 40ml grenadine in a large jug. Chill for an hour. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice, pour in the punch and finish each with a little grated nutmeg, a pineapple wedge and a cherry. Make a second jug without the rum and with soda water for the younger crew.
